description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book This Beautiful Home:* Pets are Welcome! ($250 Pet Fee Applies)* 6-Seater Golf Cart and 2 Bikes Included! (Golf Cart use is subject to $500 refundable deposit)* Complementary Beach Gear Provided for Guest Use* Walking Distance to Great Restaurant Options Including Mimmo's, Blue Mountain Creamery, Real and Raw Organic Market, and 30A Thai Cuisine* 3 Minute Ride to Blue Mountain Beach* Professional ManagedMilo’s Beach Bungalow is a beautifully renovated, pet-friendly, 3-bedroom, 3-bath retreat just steps from scenic 30A. Guests enjoy the use of two bicycles—complimentary for the duration of their stay. Thoughtfully designed with comfort and convenience in mind, this home caters to both people and pets.The inviting living room features a plush sleeper sofa (accommodating two guests), a large flat-screen TV, a faux fireplace, and a selection of games for rainy afternoons. The fully equipped kitchen boasts brand-new stainless steel appliances, along with every cooking essential imaginable, including a blender, toaster, and Keurig coffee maker.Outdoors, the fully fenced backyard is a haven for relaxation and fun. Amenities include a dedicated dog potty station with a whimsical light-up fire hydrant, a covered pergola with ample seating, a putting green, and a brand-new gas grill. String lights create a charming evening atmosphere beneath the canopy of mature Florida trees.LayoutLevel 1: Living room, kitchen, full bathroom, laundry room with large-capacity washer and dryer.Level 2: Three bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The primary suite offers a king bed and private access to the upstairs patio. The second bedroom features twin bunk beds, while the third includes a queen bed and an ensuite bathroom. All bedrooms are equipped with smart TVs and ample storage. A spacious guest bath completes the second floor.Special touches for pets include complimentary treats, a basket of toys, food and water bowls for all sizes, and a “dog photo wall” where guests can add a Polaroid of their pup to commemorate their stay (and take home a copy). A Roomba is provided for easy cleanup after sandy beach days.Whether enjoying a morning coffee on the front porch swing or grilling out in the backyard guests will feel right at home!Location HighlightsJust a short stroll from 30A, the home is within walking distance to popular spots such as Mimmo’s Italian, Coffee 30A, Ice Cream Shoppe at 30A, Real and Raw Organic Market, and 30A Thai Cuisine. Beach access is a quick 3-minute golf cart ride, and complimentary beach gear—four chairs, an umbrella, and toys—are provided. Guests will love snorkeling in the clear emerald waters or relaxing on the white sands beach!Nearby attractions include the famous Blue Mountain Creamery, boutique shopping at Lolas and The Stalls of 30A, and dining favorites like Cowgirl Kitchen, Blue Mountain Bakery, and Red Fish Taco. The San Destin Wharf and marina are just 9 miles away, offering family-friendly entertainment including fireworks every Tuesday during summer months. Golfers can enjoy three nearby courses, including Raven Golf Club, designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr. and ranked #14 in Florida by Golf Magazine.For outdoor enthusiasts, 30A offers over 16,000 acres of preserved land, with bike trails leading to destinations like Topsail Hill Preserve State Park, Grayton Beach State Park, and Point Washington State Park. Stop for fishing along the way or just enjoy the scenery!Blue Mountain Beach offers a laid-back coastal atmosphere, while Grayton Beach, Water Color, Seaside, and Rosemary Beach are only minutes away. Whether staying for a weekend or several weeks, Milo’s Beach Bungalow provides everything needed for a memorable beach getaway!Sleeping ArrangementsLevel 1: Sleeper sofa (sleeps 2)Level 2 – Bedroom 1: King bedLevel 2 – Bedroom 2: Twin bunk bedsLevel 2 – Bedroom 3: Queen bed (ensuite bathroom) Read less
